failedFirst: the setting offers each place that passes the contract, once, and none that fails or is unchecked
with no choice made, notes are kept where the host keeps them, open and change offline, and no other place is opened
a choice made is used; one no longer there is refused, never quietly swapped for the host place
a setting not understood is no choice
a move copies every note byte for byte and checks it; the old place is not changed until let go
a move into a place with other text at the same path is refused before anything is written
a copy that does not read back is taken back, so the new place is left as it was found
a note changed in the old place during the move refuses the move, and the copy is taken back
a move to the same place is refused
a move keeps the history: the notes move, and the history moves with them to its own place
